definitions.explanation: A color intermediate between blue and green, corresponding to teal or cyan in English. Distinguished from both pure blue ({青|あお}) and pure green ({緑|みどり}).

examples.japanese: ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{青緑|あおみどり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いている→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
{青緑色|あおみどりいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦タイル→タイル：29719_tairu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧バスルーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改装|かいそう}→改装：09682_kaisou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I renovated the bathroom using teal tiles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{南|みなみ}→南：00652_minami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{浅瀬|あさせ}→浅瀬：15720_asase⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{透|す}き{通|とお}った→透き通る：14316_sukitooru⟧{青緑|あおみどり}で、⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{泳|およ}いでいる→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: The shallows around the southern island were a clear blue-green, and you could see fish swimming.

notes:
A color between blue and green, corresponding to teal or cyan. In Japanese color terminology, ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ historically covered a wide range from blue to green, so {青緑|あおみどり} specifically distinguishes the intermediate hue.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {青緑色|あおみどりいろ}: blue-green color (with the ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ suffix)
- {青緑|あおみどり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧: blue-green sea
- {青緑|あおみどり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧: to shine blue-green

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{水色|みずいろ}→水色：15336_mizuiro⟧: light blue — a paler blue, like the color of water
- ⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧: green — pure green
- ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧: blue — can also cover green in traditional usage
- {翡翠色|ひすいいろ}: jade green — a similar hue named after jade stone
